newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares locked in summer doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares locked in summer doldrums.

text.p: Lithuania's listless and illiquid bourse remained locked in the summer doldrums with few gains seen on the horizon ahead of six-month results, dealers said on Thursday.
The official list, which tracks the market's five top shares, fell 17.68 points to 884.41 points.
Group A shares inched up 0.48 points to 1871.71 points while the central market turned over a sluggish 411,026 litas.
"It's quite silent," said one broker. "We can feel that it's summer."
Brokers say that summer-inspired sluggishness and anxiety over approaching six-month results are punishing shares.

Hermis Bank, which together with rival Vilniaus bank inspired the bourse's mild rally last week, remained in steady but active trading at an unchanged 190 litas in trade of 120,650 litas on the central market.
Hermis, which has become one of the darlings of the otherwise sleepy stock exchange, also saw 182,870 litas worth of block trades between 185 litas and 190 litas.
Rival Vilniaus Bank dropped to 220.10 litas from 230 litas amid a tiny central market turnover of 2,201 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese, another one of the market's few star performers, slipped to 40.50 litas from 42.00 litas amid central market turnover of 23,125 litas.
Fridge maker Snaige dropped to 12.30 litas from from 13.50 litas.
